# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Start from `AGENTS.md`; treat it as authoritative and read `docs/ai-context/00_core.md` and `01_status.md`. Use `docs/ai-context/03_folder_map.md` to select task-specific rules. Read only the applicable milestone from `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`; refer to `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for contracts.

Implement one reviewed slice, run actual quality gates, update status/evidence. RewardLab is the only default browser automation target. Microsoft Rewards is companion-only; no point farming, bot stealth, or platform-control evasion. Never claim tests passed without output.
